newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso closes off lows on dlr supply.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso closes off lows on dlr supply.

text.p: The same-day peso moderated early weakness at the close on Wednesday due to an inflow of dollars from domestic and foreign traders seeking peso-denominated investments in Mexico before the coming long weekend, traders said.
"We saw some dollars flowing in from banks selling positions and a few foreigners wishing to pick up paper before the Independence Day celebrations," a trader said.
Independence Day falls on Monday, September 16.
The same-day peso closed 1.7 centavos weaker at 7.5465/7.5500 per dollar.

The benchmark 48-hour spot peso meanwhile also checked an early slide, and was 0.2 of a centavo weaker at 7.5520/7.5570 per dollar. The 24-hour peso had reversed early weakness to stand 0.1 of a centavo firmer at 7.5470/7.5570 per dollar.
Peso traders estimated that 24-hour and 48-hour contracts could weaken in later trade if the U.S. 30-year Treasury bond yield pushes above 7.15 percent.
